title: Public surveillance forecasting of older-adult influenza/RSV hospitalization rates
description: Reproducible public-data pipeline for forecasting U.S. older-adult influenza and RSV hospitalization rates, benchmarking public surveillance signal layers against autoregressive and seasonal structure, and generating the study figures and tables from frozen public data snapshots.
